subject: general
question: The Kandariya Mahadeva temple dedicated to Lord Shiva was constructed in c.999 CE by king Dhangadeva of the _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandela dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Kandariya Mahadeva temple **dedicated to **Lord Shiva **was constructed in c.999 CE by **king Dhangadeva of the Chandela dynasty.**
 
• **King Dhangadeva of the Chandela dynasty** built the Shiva-dedicated Kandariya Mahadeva temple in 999.
 
• An elaborate gateway at the temple's entrance was decorated.
 
• Its maha mandapa main hall was where dance performances took place.
 
• An Indian dynasty in Central India was known as the **Chandelas of Jejakabhukti.**
 
• Between the 9th the 13th centuries, the Chandelas dominated a large portion of the Bundelkhand region. They belonged to the Rajput Chandel clan.
 
• The Gurjara-Pratiharas of Kanyakubja were the earliest feudatories of the Chandelas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Between the sixth and tenth centuries, the Indian kingdom** Rashtrakuta (r. 753–982 CE) **ruled over a sizable portion of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• Between the sixth through the twelfth centuries, the **Chalukya dynasty, **a Classical Indian monarchy, ruled over a sizable portion of southern and central India.
 
• An Indian dynasty known as the Kalachuris, also referred to as the **Kalachuris of Mahishmati, **ruled in west-central India throughout the sixth and seventh centuries.
